zh: 很多人拼命学AI，以为掌握工具就能赚到钱，
en: Many people study AI hard, believing tools will make them money.

zh: 但最后都会撞上同一堵墙。
en: But they eventually hit the same wall.

zh: 一家实体店，用AI一口气做出了一堆海报和文案。
en: A physical store uses AI to produce piles of posters and copy.

zh: 东西很快做出来，可发出去却没什么人看，
en: The content is made quickly, but almost nobody sees it.

zh: 顾客也没什么反应。
en: Customers barely respond.

zh: 还有人想做OPC，用AI搭建了一个小程序和行业智能体。
en: Others build a mini app or industry agent as an OPC.

zh: 演示的时候流畅稳定，
en: The demo runs smoothly and reliably,

zh: 可真正愿意落地使用的人寥寥无几。
en: yet very few people actually want to use it.

zh: 没过多久，各大平台直接上线了同质化功能。
en: Soon, major platforms launch similar features.

zh: 这时候我们就要想清楚：
en: That forces us to ask:

zh: 普通人在AI时代，真正属于我们自己的资产到底是什么？
en: What asset can ordinary people truly own in the AI era?
highlights: 真正属于我们自己的资产

zh: 我先从创造开始讲。
en: Let us start with creation.

zh: 过去拍一条视频，要设备、团队、后期。
en: Video once required equipment, a team, and post-production.

zh: 后来有了智能手机的普及，普通人创作的成本大幅下降。
en: Smartphones then sharply lowered creation costs.

zh: 现在AI继续压低门槛，写文案、作图、剪辑视频、
en: Now AI lowers the bar for copy, images, and video editing,

zh: 编写基础程序，效率持续在提升。
en: and even basic coding, raising efficiency.

zh: 相关对照的实验也能够证明，
en: Controlled studies also provide evidence

zh: AI可以加快部分任务的完成速度。
en: that AI can speed up some tasks.

zh: 当然，它不能覆盖所有的工作。
en: Of course, it does not cover every kind of work.

zh: 但足以说明，AI正在持续压低创作环节的门槛。
en: But it clearly keeps lowering the barrier to creation.

zh: 可是，创作成本降下来，
en: Yet lower creation costs

zh: 不代表分发的难题同步解决。
en: do not automatically solve distribution.

zh: 视频制作完成，发到平台，
en: A finished video still goes to a platform,

zh: 还要经过算法排序、筛选、推送，
en: where it is ranked, filtered, and distributed,

zh: 最终还要吸引路人停下来观看。
en: and must still make a passerby stop and watch.

zh: 小程序开发出来，也要用户刚好存在对应的痛点，
en: A mini app also needs users with the right pain point,

zh: 愿意点开、持续使用。
en: who are willing to open and keep using it.

zh: 能做出来、能被看见、愿意使用，
en: Being made, being seen, and being used

zh: 是三个完全不同的大门。
en: are three completely different gates.

zh: 再往下讲就是复制。
en: Next comes copying.

zh: 新工具刚兴起的时候，抢先掌握方法，
en: When a tool is new, learning it early

zh: 确实能帮助普通人快速入场。
en: can help ordinary people enter quickly.

zh: 别人还不懂，你先落地，
en: If you execute before others understand it,

zh: 短暂的信息差，可以拿到第一波的变现机会。
en: a brief information gap can create an early opportunity.

zh: 所以信息差本身没有对错，
en: The information gap itself is neither right nor wrong.

zh: 它更像是一张早鸟入场券。
en: It is more like an early-bird ticket.

zh: 但是AI同时极大加速了复制传播。
en: But AI also accelerates copying and distribution.

zh: 你的文案会被模仿，工作流会被拆解，
en: Your copy can be imitated and your workflow dismantled.

zh: 通用功能短时间内会涌现大量的同类竞品。
en: Generic features quickly attract many similar competitors.

zh: 信息快速扩散，教程随处可得，模板无限复用，
en: Information spreads, tutorials abound, and templates are reused.

zh: 短暂的领先优势，很快就会被抹平。
en: A temporary lead is quickly erased.

zh: 这时候真正要思考的，不是这波红利还能赚多久，
en: The question is not how long the current bonus will last,

zh: 而是红利窗口还在的时候，你到底沉淀下了什么。
en: but what you retain while the window is still open.

zh: 普通人开发的很多中间层工具，
en: Many middle-layer tools built by ordinary people

zh: 一旦被市场验证具备价值，
en: may prove valuable in the market,

zh: 大模型厂商、平台方很容易直接整合同类功能。
en: yet model makers and platforms can integrate similar functions.

zh: 越是通用标准化的功能，越无法当成长久的壁垒。
en: The more generic and standard a feature is, the weaker its moat.

zh: 一个按钮、一套话术，都可以被轻易复制。
en: A button or a script can be copied easily.

zh: 什么才是普通人在这个时代真正值得守住的东西？
en: So what is truly worth protecting in this era?

zh: 答案是：信任。
en: The answer is trust.

zh: 我们把信任和分发放在一起看。
en: We need to examine trust together with distribution.

zh: 内容、产品越来越泛滥，平台负责筛选推送；
en: As content and products multiply, platforms filter and distribute.

zh: 创作者依靠平台，把作品送到用户面前。
en: Creators rely on platforms to reach users.

zh: 这不代表算法天然偏爱真实，
en: That does not mean algorithms naturally favor authenticity,

zh: 更不是只要足够真实，就一定能拿到流量。
en: or that being authentic guarantees traffic.

zh: 更现实的问题是：当一个人点进你的内容，
en: The practical question is: when someone opens your content,

zh: 你有没有足够完整的素材，支撑对方客观的判断？
en: do you have enough material for an objective judgment?

zh: 这里就要说到Build in Public。
en: This is where Build in Public matters.

zh: 它不是设计一个永远完美的人设，
en: It is not about designing a permanently perfect persona,

zh: 也不是每天流水账式地分享私生活。
en: or posting a daily diary of private life.

zh: 它本质是持续公开一件真实的事：
en: It means continually sharing one real undertaking:

zh: 需求从哪里来，你做了哪些尝试，
en: where the need came from and what you tried,

zh: 哪里失败出错，谁参与验证，
en: what failed and who helped verify it,

zh: 后续又如何迭代优化。
en: and how you later improved it.

zh: 单次记录只是碎片，无数条相关记录串联在一起，
en: One record is only a fragment; many related records form a chain.

zh: 最终形成属于你完整的个人历史。
en: Together they become your complete personal history.

zh: 讲到这里，我必须给“在场即信任”
en: Here, “presence equals trust”

zh: 加上一条关键边界：
en: needs one crucial boundary:

zh: 持续在场，本身不等于信任。
en: Continued presence alone is not trust.

zh: 社交相关研究显示，并不是公开的信息越多，
en: Social research suggests that sharing more information

zh: 可信度就越高。
en: does not automatically increase credibility.

zh: 披露恰到好处，能够建立信任；
en: Appropriate disclosure can build trust,

zh: 不合时宜的过度袒露，反而会降低别人对你的评价。
en: while misplaced over-disclosure can reduce evaluations.

zh: 持续更新、持续露面，只是构建信任的原材料，
en: Regular updates and appearances are only raw material for trust,

zh: 绝非最终结果。
en: not the final result.

zh: 别人可以抄袭你的标题、模仿你的表达方式，
en: Others can copy your titles and imitate your expression,

zh: 做出功能相近的产品。
en: or build a product with similar features.

zh: 但对手很难在短时间内补齐你全部历程：
en: But they cannot quickly reproduce your whole journey:

zh: 你曾经解决过什么真实的难题，
en: the real problems you solved,

zh: 做过哪些关键性的判断，踩过哪些坑，
en: the judgments you made and the mistakes you survived,

zh: 方案经过了多少客户的验证。
en: and how much customer validation your work received.

zh: 这也是为什么普通人需要同时吃透AI和自媒体。
en: That is why ordinary people need both AI and self-media.

zh: AI帮你降低创作成本，
en: AI lowers creation costs.

zh: 信息差给你一张早期入场门票；
en: An information gap gives you an early entry ticket.

zh: 自媒体让你探索过程有机会被外界看到。
en: Self-media gives others a chance to see your exploration.

zh: 单纯的复制无法形成长期的竞争力，
en: Copying alone cannot create lasting competitiveness.

zh: 被看见，也不等于获取信任。
en: Being seen is not the same as earning trust.

zh: 真正值得长期沉淀的资产，
en: The asset worth accumulating over time

zh: 是一条扎根真实问题、可供外人核验、
en: is a timeline rooted in real problems and open to verification,

zh: 敢于坦诚标注“这里尚未验证”的完整时间线。
en: one that honestly labels what remains unverified.

zh: 它无法保证平台持续给你流量，
en: It cannot guarantee continued platform traffic,

zh: 也不能确保客户一定会选择你。
en: or ensure that customers will choose you.

zh: 但是当别人想要评估你、信任你的时候，
en: But when someone wants to evaluate and trust you,

zh: 手里终于拥有了足够的证据。
en: they finally have enough evidence.

zh: 不用等到做出成绩再开始行动。
en: You do not need to wait for success before starting.

zh: 就拿你当下正在推进的项目，
en: Take the project you are working on now

zh: 借助AI开启你的记录之路。
en: and use AI to begin documenting it.

zh: 别急着向所有人证明你已经成功。
en: Do not rush to prove that you have already succeeded.

zh: 先讲清楚你做过什么，
en: First explain what you have done,

zh: 哪些方面值得验证，
en: what is worth validating,

zh: 还有哪些方面依旧没有验证。
en: and what still remains unverified.

zh: 如果你现在正在借助AI做项目，
en: If you are using AI on a project right now,

zh: 可以评论区聊聊，你目前最大的卡点是什么？
en: tell me in the comments: what is your biggest obstacle?

zh: 关注我，我是超哥，在兰州AI创业。
en: Follow me. I am Chao, building an AI venture in Lanzhou.
